summary: Skier killed in avalanche on Torreys Peak
notes: Reported in avalanche-center 2014-15 season index; county not verified Alpine Rescue Team was paged Code 3 for this avalanche response 12/31/14 10:46 (Alpine 2014 annual mission summary, mission 14-133, logged as the Kelso Mountain area; Kelso Mountain is adjacent to Torreys Peak on the same massif). CAIC classic table (opened 2026-09-12) lists this as 12/31 Kelso Mountain: 'One climber, traveling on snowshoes, caught, buried, and killed' — consistent with the Alpine mission 14-133 Kelso Mountain logging.
